content: Ɔsʋrapʋ Mʋa Asʋ́n Ogyípʋ́ Ɔkʋ
Ɩnʋ Yesu lɛ́ha yébi kʋ pʋ́súná ánɩ́ bʋbɔ́ɔ mpáɩ brégyíbrɛ́, ɩmákpɔn amʋ́.
Ɔlɛbláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Asʋ́n ogyípʋ́ ɔkʋ létsiá wúlu kʋsʋ. Ɔtamanyá Bulu ifú, ɔtamanyá ɔhaa ɛ́ pɛ́lɩ.
Ɔsʋrapʋ ɔkʋ ɛ́ létsiá wúlu amʋtɔ. Oletsiá bokokóli mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ogyíi mʋ asʋ́n ɔnɔkwalɩsʋ ha mʋ, ɔlɛ mʋ tsu mʋ olupʋ́ ɩbɩtɔ!
Tɛkɩ olekle okina, támɛ ɔma-ɔma a, ɔlɛbláa mʋ ɩwɩ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Ɩbʋ mʋ́tɔ́á ntamanyá Bulu ifú, ntamanyá ɔhaa ɛ́ pɛ́lɩ.
Támɛ alɩ ánfɩ ɔsʋrapʋ anfɩ ná ɔdɛ mɩ́ háan anfɩ sʋ á, négyi mʋ asʋ́n ɔnɔkwalɩsʋ. Nɩ́ megyí alɩ á, oméesi mɩ́ tɔ́ɩ wa. Ɔmɛ́ɛha mméenya ɔkpa bwɛ́ tɔtɔ.’ ”
Yesu lɔ́yɔ mʋ́sʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩkɩ alɩá asʋ́n ogyípʋ́ anfɩ́ ɔtamagyi asʋ́n ɔnɔkwalɩsʋ ánfɩ lablɩ́.
Mʋ́mʋ́ nkálɩ Bulu mʋ́ méegyi mʋ ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ alalɛ́, bʋdesú kpolí mʋ ɔpa-onyé ámʋ asʋ́n ɔnɔkwalɩsʋ? Obési amʋ́ asʋ́n wá obíátɔ́? Ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ!
Ndɛ mlɩ bláa mbɛ́ɛ, obégyi mʋ́ ɔnɔkwalɩsʋ há amʋ́ ɔsasʋ. Támɛ ndɛfɩtɛ́ mbɛ́ɛ, nɩ́ mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ neyínkí bá a, nówun ahógyipʋ akʋ ɔsʋlʋ́ʋ anfɩsʋ?”
Lampóo Ɔhɔ́pʋ Mʋa Farisiyin
Yesu lɛ́trá ha yébi kʋ pʋ́súná amʋ́ atɔ́ tsú ahá ánɩ́ bʋtɛkɩ amʋ́ ɩwɩ yilé abwɛpʋ́ dʋn amʋ́ aba.
Ɔlɛha yébi amʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ayin abanyɔ́ akʋ bɔdʋ yɔ́ mpáɩ ɔbɔkpá Bulu ɔtswɛ́kpa. Amʋ́tɔ́ ɔkʋlɛ gyí Farisiyin, ɔkʋlɛ ɛ́ gyí lampóo ɔhɔ́pʋ.
“Farisiyin amʋ lɔ́kʋsʋ́ lɩ́ɩ́, bɔ́ mpáɩ wá nwuntɔ ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Bulu, nɛdá fʋ́ ɩpán ánɩ́ mmegyí fɛ́ akʋ. Mɩ́ mʋ́ mma ɔnsɩ́pɛ, ntamasísi ɔha, ntamatɔ́ mbʋa, mmegyí fɛ́ Lampóo ɔhɔ́pʋ anfɩ ɛ́.
Ntɛklɩ́ ɔnɔ́ tse nyɔ ndawɔ́tswɩ́ ɩkʋlɛtɔ. Nteye mɩ́ atɔ́ fɛ́ɛ́tɔ́ dú, lɛ́ idúsɩ́ há fʋ́.’

“Támɛ lampóo ɔhɔ́pʋ amʋ mʋ́ lɛ́yɛlɩɩ́ tsútsú, oloko nwuntɔ wá. Omotsulá tsú ansɩ́ kʋ́ráá fʋ́á kɩ ɔsʋ́sʋ́. Ɔlɔpʋ ɔbɩmáa dá ɩbɩtɔ, kókóli Bulu ɔbɛ́ɛ, ‘Óo Bulu, wun mɩ nwɛ, lakpan ɔbwɛpʋ́ ngyi.’ ”

Yesu lɔ́mɔ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ndɛ mlɩ bláa mbɛ́ɛ, asa beyinkí yɔ́ wóyí á, Bulu ansɩ́ légyi lampóo ɔhɔ́pʋ amʋ ɩwɩ dʋn Farisiyin amʋ. Tsúfɛ́ ɔhá ánɩ́ ototsú ɩwɩ á, Bulu ɔbɛ́ba mʋ asɩ. Ɔhá ánɩ́ ɔtɛba ɩwɩasɩ ɛ́ á, Bulu obótsu mʋ fʋ́á.”
Nyebí Yulá
Aha akʋ bɔpʋ amʋ́ abí ba Yesu bɛɛ, ɔpʋ́ʋ ɩbɩ dɩnka amʋ́sʋ́, oyula amʋ́. Mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ bowun amʋ́. Mʋ́ sʋ bɔwa ɩyɩn wá amʋ́.
Támɛ Yesu lɛ́tɩ nyebí ámʋ ba mʋ ɩwɩ wá, ɔlɛbláa akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩha nyebí ámʋ abʋba mɩ́ wá. Mlɩmátin amʋ́ ɔkpa, tsúfɛ́ ahá ánfɩ odu bʋ́ Bulu iwíegyí amʋ nɩ.
Ɔnɔkwalɩ ndɛ mlɩ bláa. Ɔhá ánɩ́ ɔmɔhɔ Bulu iwíegyí ámʋ fɛ́ kebi á, omóowie mʋ́tɔ́.”
Atonyahɛ́ Ɩwɩ Atosunáhɛ́
Ɛkɛ ɔkʋ Yudafɔ ɔhandɛ ɔkʋ lɛ́bɛfɩtɛ́ Yesu ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Osunápʋ́ yilé, ntɔ nɔ́bwɛ asa nénya nkpa ánɩ́ ɩtamatá?”
Yesu lɛ́fɩtɛ́ mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ntogyi sʋ́ fʋdɛ mɩ́ tɩ ɔha yilé? Ɔhaa mégyí ɔha yilé, nkɛ́tɩ Bulu nkʋlɛ.
Yɛ́ɛ fʋyin Bulu mbla ámʋ o. Mʋ́gyí, mátɔ mbʋa, mámɔ ɔha, máwi atɔ́, máka asʋ́n dɩ́nká fʋ́ básʋ́, bu fʋ́ sí mʋa fʋ́ yín.”
Ɔhandɛ amʋ lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Tsú mɩ́ nyebitɔ ɔpá ndɛ mʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́sʋ́ gyí.”

Yesu lónu mʋ asʋn blɩ́hɛ́ anfɩ á, ɔlɛbláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Toku kʋlɛ ɩlasí ánɩ́ fɔ́bwɛ. Yɛfɛ fʋ́ ɩwɩsʋ atɔ́ fɛ́ɛ́, afʋye kɔ́ba amʋ ha ahiánfɔ, mɛ́nɩ fénya siadɩɛ ɔsʋ́sʋ́. Fɔbwɛ́ mʋ́ tá á, ba afʋbobuo mɩ.”
Brɛ́á oyin ámʋ lónu asʋ́n ánfɩ á, ɩlɔtɔ mʋ klʋn, tsúfɛ́ ɔhɩ́ɛ́ ɔbʋ atɔ́.
Yesu lówun ánɩ́ ɩlahan mʋ. Mʋ́ sʋ ɔlɛblɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɩbʋ ɔnlɩn asa ɩwɩ onyapʋ́ obówie Bulu iwíegyí ámʋtɔ.
Lɛ́lɛ́ mʋ́ á, ɩlɔpɔn ha kpɔ́sɔ́ ánɩ́ ɔbɔ́tsʋn ɔbɩn-atɔ ɔbɔ́tɔ́, dʋn ánɩ́ ɩwɩ onyapʋ́ obówie Bulu iwíegyí ámʋtɔ.”
Ahá ánɩ́ bonu asʋ́n ánfɩ bɛfɩtɛ́ bɛɛ, “Mʋ́mʋ́ ma mɛɛ Bulu ɔbɔ́hɔ nkpa?”
Támɛ Yesu lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Tɔ́á nyankpʋsa mɛ́ɛtalɩ́ bwɛ́ mɔdʋ́n Bulu bwɛ.”
Ɩnʋ Petro lɛ́bláa Yesu ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mɩ́ Wíe, kɩ, anɩlasí anɩ wóyí tswɩ bobuo fʋ.”
Yesu lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɔnɔkwalɩ ndɛ mlɩ bláa. Ɔhaa má ɩnʋá obési mʋ wóyí, mʋ ka, mʋ apíó, mʋ akwɩɩ́pʋ́ ntɛ́ɛ mʋ abí tswɩ Bulu iwíegyí ámʋ sʋ,
Bulu mɛ́ɛlawá mʋ́ otsiákpá há mʋ tsé dú tsé lafa séi, láha mʋ nkpa ánɩ́ ɩtamatá brɛ́ ámʋ́ʋ́ ɩbá ámʋtɔ.”
Yesu Lowu Ɩwɩ Asʋ́n Blɩ́ Otse Saasɩ

Yesu lɛ́tɩ akasɩ́pʋ́ dúanyɔ ámʋ ya ɩtsɛ́tɔ́, ɔlɛbláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ayɔ́ Yerusalem. Ɩnʋ́ asʋ́n ámʋ́ʋ́ Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ atɔɩ́pʋ́ amʋ bɔwanlɩ́n tsú mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ ɩwɩ ámʋ fɛ́ɛ́ bɛ́ba mʋ́tɔ́ nɩ́.
Bɛ́lɛ mɩ́ há ahá ánɩ́ bʋmegyí Yudafɔ. Bɔ́bwɛ mɩ́ ahinlá, síá mɩ́, tú atsʋnɔ́ wʋ́lɩ́ mɩ́.
Bɛ́pɩtɩ́ mɩ́ atɔ́, mɔ́ mɩ́. Mʋ́ ɛkɛ sáásɩ́ a, nɔ́kʋsʋ́ tsú afúlitɔ.”
Akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ bʋmonu ɩ́nɩ asɩ, tsúfɛ́ Bulu lɔ́pʋŋáín amʋ́. Bʋmɛbɩ tɔ́á ɔdɛblɩ́ ɛ́.
Ansibi Obwiepʋ́ Ɔkʋ Ɩlɔ Tsa
Yesu lɛ́ta Yeriko wúlutɔ wie tá á, ansibi obwiepʋ́ ɔkʋ tsie ɔkpa ɔnɔ́, ɔdɛ atɔ́ kʋlɩ́.
Ansibi obwiepʋ́ ámʋ lónu ánɩ́ ɔdɔm bʋdɛtsʋ́ʋn. Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛfɩtɛ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Amansʋ igyi?”
Ahá bɛbláa mʋ bɛɛ, “Yesu Nasaretyin amʋ dɛ́tsʋ́ʋn.”
Ɩnʋ ansibi obwiepʋ́ ámʋ lɔ́kplʋn blɩ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Anɩ wíe Dawid mʋ na Yesu, wun mɩ nwɛ!”
Ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ bʋgya Yesu nkpá ámʋ bɔkplʋ́n wa ansibi obwiepʋ́ ámʋ bɛɛ, ɔwáa ɔsa kpa ɔnɔ́ bun. Ɔlɛlakplʋ́n dʋn alɩ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Anɩ wíe Dawid mʋ na, wun mɩ nwɛ!”
Yesu lési lɩɩ́, ɔlɛha ɔbɛ́ɛ bʋkpá mʋ ba mʋ. Brɛ́á bɛkpa mʋ ba a, Yesu lɛ́fɩtɛ́ mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ,
“Ntɔ fʋdeklé fɛɛ mbwɛ́ɛ ha fʋ?” Ɔlɛlɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Owíe, ha mɩ́ anwun atɔ́!”
Yesu lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Fʋ́ hógyi latsá fʋ́ ɩlɔ. Wun atɔ́.”
Ɩnʋnʋ mʋ ansíbi lobwií, ɔlɛkplá buo Yesu, ɔdɛ Bulu kanfʋ́. Ɔdɔm amʋ fɛ́ɛ́ bowun ɩ́nɩ, amʋ́ ɛ́ bɛkanfʋ́ Bulu.
